brief:
Israel has threatened Palestinian groups against launching kites, drones, and balloons from Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The threat marks an escalation in tensions over the use of such flying objects as delivery mechanisms for incendiary devices targeting Israeli territory.

Palestinian activists have employed kites and balloons rigged with flammable materials to cross the border into southern Israel, sparking fires across communities near Gaza. The practice has prompted repeated Israeli military responses, with the country launching airstrikes on targets within the enclave in what officials characterize as necessary defensive measures. Israel has accused Palestinian groups of using the attacks as cover for broader military activity.
dek: Israel has threatened Palestinian groups against launching 'kites, drones, and balloons' from the war-torn enclave.
title: Israel threatens Gaza Palestinians over kites, drones, balloons
